scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; export PORT=${API_PORT:-8080}; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev'
scripts.dev:web: sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; export PORT=${WEB_PORT:-26015}; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/tech-blog run dev'
scripts.dev:mockups: sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; export PORT=${MOCKUP_PORT:-8081}; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run dev'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.validate:development-storage: sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run validate:development-storage'
